rule.name: HashOrderInOrderedOutput
rule.message: Hash order reaches ordered output here: a HashSet or HashMap (or an unsorted stream over it) is joined into a string or appended to a StringBuilder or StringJoiner in a loop, or, when its keys are Class, enum or Object values hashed by identity, copied into a returned list or array. The order differs between JVMs and library versions, so generated files, SQL and schemas change between builds and tests flake. Create a LinkedHashSet or LinkedHashMap (or a TreeSet or TreeMap) instead, or sort before the sink (`set.stream().sorted().collect(Collectors.joining(","))`). An exception fits only for output whose order is irrelevant, such as a set shown in a log line.
